title: Similar incursions at Norfolk Naval Base and over DC
summary: Ryan Graves tells of Similar incursions at Norfolk Naval Base and over DC, about recent (not stated) at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Norfolk Naval Base, Virginia; Washington, DC

tellings.quote: they had similar incursions at uh, Norphick, um, the Norfick Naval Base,

plain: A former Navy fighter pilot named Ryan Graves, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, passes on what someone told him: unknown objects had made similar incursions, meaning they entered protected airspace without permission, at Norfolk Naval Base in Virginia and over Washington, DC. He gives no date. If true, it would mean unexplained objects were moving freely over a major military base and the nation's capital.
